cards.text:
复仇之爪
阵营规则
阿斯塔特
这些通过基因强化的超人类只为一个目的而存在：
战争。
在每一名己方复仇之爪特工激活时，特工可以
执行两次近战行动或两次射击行动。若执行两次
射击行动，则其中至少一次需要选择爆矢手枪，
爆矢枪或带瞄准镜的爆矢手枪进行射击。
每一名己方复仇之爪特工无论拥有什么命令都
可以执行反应。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
FACTION RULE
ASTARTES
These genetically modified superhumans are made for
one purpose: war.
During each friendly NEMESIS CLAW operative’s
activation, it can perform either two Shoot
actions or two Fight actions. If it’s two Shoot
actions, a bolt pistol, boltgun or scoped bolt pistol
must be selected for at least one of them.
Each friendly NEMESIS CLAW operative can
counteract regardless of its order.

cards.text:
复仇之爪
阵营规则
身披午夜
黑暗伴随着午夜领主，成为他们的盟友和武器。
每当一名敌方特工对一名己方复仇之爪特工进
行射击时，若那名己方特工满足下列所有条件，
则其处于遮挡：
• 对其可见的敌方特工距离它超过 8"。
• 它位于重型地形 1" 内且不低于它，或它的底
盘的任意部分位于制高点之下。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
FACTION RULE
IN MIDNIGHT CLAD
Night Lords are one with the darkness, employing it as
an ally and a weapon.
Whenever an enemy operative is shooting a
friendly NEMESIS CLAW operative, that friendly
operative is obscured if both of the following
are true:
• It’s more than 8" from enemy operatives it’s
visible to.
• It’s within 1" of Heavy terrain that’s not lower
than it, or any part of its base is underneath
Vantage terrain.

cards.text:
复仇之爪
战略计谋
我们为你而来
午夜领主对敌人发起的突袭极为迅速，在对手
拿起利刃反击前会报以震撼，惊愕和恐怖至极
的残暴。
每当一名己方复仇之爪特工激活时，若那次激
活的第一个行动为冲锋行动，则它可以在那次行
动的移动结束时对其控制范围内的一名敌方特工
造成 D3 点伤害。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
STRATEGY PLOY
WE HAVE COME FOR YOU
The Night Lords strike their foes swiftly, utilising shock,
awe and terror to brutalise the enemy before they can
lift a blade in response.
Whenever a friendly NEMESIS CLAW operative
is activated, if the first action it performs during
that activation is the Charge action, when it
ends its move during that action, you can inflict
D3 damage on one enemy operative within its
control range.

cards.text:
复仇之爪
战略计谋
黑暗狩猎
每一名午夜领主的两颗心脏中都燃烧着可怕的
恶意，而玩弄受伤的猎物正是他们的最爱。
每当一名己方复仇之爪特工对受伤的敌方特工
进行射击，近战或反击时，您可以重掷一枚攻
击骰。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
STRATEGY PLOY
THE BLACK HUNT
A terrible malice burns within the twin hearts of each
Night Lord, and they enjoy nothing more than toying
with their wounded prey.
Whenever a friendly NEMESIS CLAW operative
is shooting against, fighting against or retaliating
against a wounded enemy operative, you can
re-roll one of your attack dice.

cards.text:
复仇之爪
战略计谋
猎杀视觉
午夜领主能感知到猎物畏缩时的恐惧，随之便
用精准的追猎捉拿他们。
每当您为一名己方复仇之爪特工执行射击行动
时您可以使用这个规则。若此，直至那次行动结
束，那名己方特工的远程武器获得“范围 6"”
和“追踪轻型”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
STRATEGY PLOY
PREYSIGHT
The Night Lords seem able to sense the fear of cowering
prey, hunting down the craven with unerring precision.
Whenever a friendly NEMESIS CLAW operative
performs the Shoot action, you can use this rule.
If you do, until the end of that action, that friendly
operative’s ranged weapons have the Range 6"
and Seek Light weapon rules.

cards.text:
复仇之爪
战略计谋
归于黑暗
尽管午夜领主拥有远超人类的巨大体格，但机
敏迅捷地穿行于一片片阴影之间对他们而言完
全不成问题。
一名己方复仇之爪特工可以立即执行一次无消
耗的后撤或转移行动，但它结束移动时必须有重
型地形位于其控制范围内，或其底座任意部分位
于制高点地形下方，而且它不能在那次行动中移
动超过 4"，并且不能在移动结束时更靠近敌方特
工（在使用近距离战斗规则的杀戮区中，例如杀
戮区：墓穴世界，在结算本规则时忽略墙壁地形
模型）。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
STRATEGY PLOY
RETURN TO DARKNESS
The Night Lords move from shadow to shadow with an
agility and speed belied by their transhuman bulk.
One friendly NEMESIS CLAW operative
can immediately perform a free Fall Back or
Reposition action, but it must end that move
with Heavy terrain within its control range, or
any part of its base underneath Vantage terrain.
In addition, it cannot move more than 4" during
that action and it cannot end that move closer
to enemy operatives (in a killzone that uses the
close quarters rules, e.g. Killzone: Tomb World,
ignore Wall terrain when determining this).

cards.text:
复仇之爪
交战计谋
尖啸音频
通过调整其头盔的内建发声单元的频率，午夜
领主们能够发出足以令敌人眩晕的可怕尖啸。
在您的对手激活一名对己方复仇之爪特工可见
的敌方特工时使用此交战计谋。掷一枚 D6；如
果掷骰结果大于那名敌方特工的 APL 属性，那
么您的对手无法在这次激活中激活那名特工；如
果掷骰结果低于那名敌方特工的 APL 属性，那
么这次计谋不会被使用，并且返还消耗的 CP，
在那之后，您不能在当前转折点中再次使用本
计谋。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
FIREFIGHT PLOY
VOX SCREAM
By modulating the frequency of their helm-mounted
vox-units, Night Lord operatives can unleash a terrifying
scream with the ability to stun an opponent.
Use this firefight ploy when your opponent would
activate an enemy operative that’s visible to a
friendly NEMESIS CLAW operative. Roll one D6;
if the result is higher than that enemy operative’s
APL stat, your opponent cannot activate it during
this activation; if the result is less than or equal
to that enemy operative’s APL stat, this ploy isn’t
used, the CP spent on it is refunded and you
cannot use this ploy again during this turning
point. If there are no other enemy operatives
eligible to be activated, this ploy has no effect.

cards.text:
复仇之爪
交战计谋
诛杀伪帝
和其他阿斯塔特叛军一样，午夜领主也对崇拜
着那具尸体的帝国士兵抱有特别的恨意。
当一名己方复仇之爪特工对拥有帝国关键词的
敌方特工进行射击，近战或反击时，在掷攻击骰
后使用此交战计谋。那名己方特工的武器在那个
流程结束前获得“无休”武器规则；若那名敌方
特工还拥有阿斯塔特修会关键词，则那个己方特
工的武器在那个流程结束前会改为获得“毫不留
情”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
FIREFIGHT PLOY
DEATH TO THE FALSE EMPEROR
The Night Lords, like all Heretic Astartes, bear a
particular hatred for the corpse-worshipping soldiers of
the Imperium.
Use this firefight ploy after rolling your attack
dice for a friendly NEMESIS CLAW operative,
if it’s shooting against, fighting against or
retaliating against an enemy operative that has
the IMPERIUM keyword. That friendly operative’s
weapons have the Ceaseless weapon rule
until the end of that sequence; if that enemy
operative also has the ADEPTUS ASTARTES
keyword, that friendly operative’s weapons have
the Relentless weapon rule until the end of that
sequence instead.

cards.text:
复仇之爪
交战计谋
杀戮癖
每一次残杀都能满足午夜领主的嗜血欲，并激
励着他们做出更为残暴的行为。
在一名己方复仇之爪特工令位于其控制范围内
的一名敌方特工残废时使用此交战计谋。那个己
方特工可以立即执行一次至多为 3" 的无消耗冲
锋行动或冲刺行动（如果是前者，移动距离不能
超过 3"），即使在那次激活中您已经执行过某行
动会阻止您执行冲锋或冲刺行动，也不会影响这
个行动的执行。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
FIREFIGHT PLOY
PROCLIVITY FOR MURDER
Each brutal kill a Night Lord performs serves to feed
their bloodlust and drives them to further acts of
terrible violence.
Use this firefight ploy after a friendly NEMESIS
CLAW operative incapacitates an enemy
operative within its control range. That friendly
operative can immediately perform a free Charge
or Dash action (for the former, it cannot move
more than 3"), even if it’s performed an action
that prevents it from performing those actions.

cards.text:
复仇之爪
交战计谋
卑鄙战士
午夜领主对荣耀这类概念毫无敬意，只要有必
要，他们会使用任何卑鄙战术。
当一名就绪的己方复仇之爪特工在反击的结算
攻击骰步骤开始时，使用此交战计谋。您可以在
正常顺序前先结算一次成功，这样做的话，在那
次流程中您不能结算任意其他成功。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
FIREFIGHT PLOY
DIRTY FIGHTER
The Night Lords have no respect for the concept of
honour and will use whatever underhanded tactics they
deem necessary.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly NEMESIS
CLAW operative is retaliating, at the start of the
Resolve Attack Dice step. You can resolve one of
your successes before the normal order. If you do,
you cannot resolve any other successes during
that sequence.

cards.text:
复仇之爪
阵营装备
剥制皮肤
午夜领主身披被屠戮者的皮肤，敌人因此感到
极度恐惧和厌恶。
每当一名敌方特工对位于其 2" 内的一名己方复
仇之爪特工进行射击，近战或反击时，您的对
手无法重掷结果为 1 的攻击骰。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
FACTION EQUIPMENT
FLAYED SKIN
Bedecked with the bloody hides of butchered victims,
the Night Lords inspire abject terror and revulsion in
their enemies.
Whenever an enemy operative is shooting
against, fighting against or retaliating against a
friendly NEMESIS CLAW operative within 2" of
it, your opponent cannot re-roll their attack dice
results of 1.

cards.text:
复仇之爪
阵营装备
链缚陷阱
这种能紧咬血肉或护甲的武器由一条附有带钩
利刃的修长链条组成，能够阻止敌人逃跑。
每当位于一名己方复仇之爪特工控制范围内的
一名敌方特工执行后撤行动时，若没有其他敌方
特工位于那名己方战士的控制范围内，则您可
以使用这个规则。若此，掷两枚 D6，若那名敌
方特工的耐伤属性高于那名己方特工，则掷一枚
D6：若有任意掷骰结果为 4+，则那名敌方特工
在那次激活或反应中无法执行那个行动（这不会
消耗 AP），并且您不能在当前转折点中再次使
用这个规则。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
FACTION EQUIPMENT
CHAIN SNARE
Composed of hooked blades attached to a length of
chain, this weapon bites into the flesh or armour of the
wielder’s target, preventing them from fleeing.
Whenever an enemy operative would perform
the Fall Back action while within control range
of a friendly NEMESIS CLAW operative, if no
other enemy operatives are within that friendly
operative’s control range, you can use this rule.
If you do, roll two D6, or one D6 if that enemy
operative has a higher Wounds stat than that
friendly operative. If any result is a 4+, that enemy
operative cannot perform that action during that
activation/counteraction (no AP are spent on it),
and you cannot use this rule again during this
turning point.

cards.text:
复仇之爪
阵营装备
惊悚战利品
断肢，断手，从尖叫受害者的头颅中拔出的眼
球——这类耸人听闻的战利品能使午夜领主之
敌在战栗中动摇。
每场战斗限一次，当一名己方复仇之爪特工使
位于其 2" 内的一名敌方特工残废时，您可以使
用本规则。若此，那名己方特工获得己方惊悚战
利品指示物（如果它尚未拥有这种指示物）。当
拥有己方惊悚战利品的一名己方复仇之爪特工
位于一名敌方特工 2" 内且对其可见时，将那名
敌方特工武器的攻击属性减去 1 点。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
FACTION EQUIPMENT
GRISLY TROPHY
Severed hands and limbs, eyeballs plucked from the
skulls of screaming victims – these macabre trophies
and more cause the Night Lords’ foes to waver.
Once per battle, when a friendly NEMESIS CLAW
operative incapacitates an enemy operative
within 2" of it, you can use this rule. If you do, that
friendly operative gains one of your Grisly Trophy
tokens (if it doesn’t already have one). Whenever
a friendly NEMESIS CLAW operative that has
one of your Grisly Trophy tokens is visible to and
within 2" of an enemy operative, subtract 1 from
the Atk stat of that enemy operative’s weapons.

cards.text:
复仇之爪
阵营装备
通讯干扰器
在午夜领主们的干扰装置影响下，惊慌失措的
敌人无法通讯，进一步扩大了混乱的战况。
当一名敌方特工位于一名己方复仇之爪特工 3"
内时，那名敌方特工的 APL 属性无法提升。请
注意，这并不能影响已经改变的 APL 属性。
cards.text_en:
NEMESIS CLAW
FACTION EQUIPMENT
COMMS JAMMERS
The Night Lords use jamming devices to sow chaos
and confusion by preventing their panicked foes
from communicating.
Whenever an enemy operative is within 3" of a
friendly NEMESIS CLAW operative, that enemy
operative’s APL stat cannot be added to. Note
that this doesn’t affect APL stats that have
already been changed.
